title: Animated illustration family

location.extent: Complete published video; PNG is one poster frame

slide_intent: Keep a shared material and movement character across different symbols so each remains part of one family.
strategic_value: Repeated textured surfaces and gentle rotations can tie Wise’s varied functional metaphors together.
demonstration: Eight objects sit in two rows on white: megaphone, globe, bell, location pin, banknote, flag, heart and paper plane. They rotate or move while retaining their positions.
practical_value: Compare consistency of texture, lighting and motion across unrelated object silhouettes.

content_islands.name: Upper row
content_islands.spec: Align four objects with clear space between their forms.

content_islands.name: Lower row
content_islands.spec: Repeat the spacing for four further objects.

content_islands.name: Movement
content_islands.spec: Animate each form locally without dissolving the two-row comparison.
